scope: Read-only source-closure review of the new regional counterfactual helper; no production code defect found.

runtimeDependencyProof.use: calculateRegionalFromInputs returns claim and milestoneDefinition from REGIONAL_COUNTERFACTUAL.
deriveLegacyExport regional branch calls regionalCounterfactualRows on the actual retained parent.

producerIdentityProof.sourceCapture: server/snapshots/calculationSourceArtifact.ts recursively archives all server, shared and client/src TS/TSX/JSON/CSV bytes plus package/config/lock bytes. The helper is not an omitted allowlist dependency.
producerIdentityProof.sourceIdentity: contentHash(payload) includes the actual helper text; changing only that text changes the source archive identity.
producerIdentityProof.loadedImplementation: server/snapshots/legacyExportProducer.ts captures supportedCodeArchiveId alongside loaded producer modules and rejects captureSource returning a different release.
producerIdentityProof.materialAndManifest: retainLegacyProducer records sourceArchive in legacy-export-material-1 and as manifest.codeVersion; createManifest hashes codeVersion with modelVersion, snapshots, scenario and settings.
producerIdentityProof.modelVersionBoundary: CALCULATION_VERSION continues to identify the unchanged numerical model contract, not a byte-level build. The full producer manifest identity changes with helper bytes even when that numerical model version is unchanged.

retainedReplayProof.entry: server/snapshots/results.ts loadAnalysisResultNode routes legacy-export scenarios through verifyLegacyExportMaterial.
retainedReplayProof.archiveIntegrity: server/snapshots/materialInputs.ts loadMaterialArchive authenticates the retained archive content hash. verifyLegacyExportMaterial additionally checks the source payload hash itself.
retainedReplayProof.historicalReleasePolicy: Legacy replay supports only the exact source release loaded by the process. An older or independently rehashed helper-less/helper-corrupt archive is rejected as unsupported; it is not rebuilt using current helper bytes.
targetedFaults: Delete helper from archive while preserving claimed source ID: code archive corrupt.
Corrupt helper text while preserving claimed source ID: code archive corrupt.
Delete helper and rehash archive/material/manifest consistently: unsupported release.
Corrupt helper and rehash archive/material/manifest consistently: unsupported release.
retainedReplayProof.faultBoundary: All four targeted faults reject before reading retained input or invoking whole producer replay.

routeCacheReview.state: regionalCacheResult starts null and regionalCacheFetchedAt starts zero in module-local memory.
routeCacheReview.readWriteClosure: The regional route only reads this process-local object and writes results from its loaded calculateRegionalProjections implementation. It does not load regional response rows from projection_cache or storage. Selected regionalSnapshotId requests bypass this cache.
routeCacheReview.mutationBoundary: respond uses detachProjectionCacheResponse, which structured-clones the cached object before downstream response consumers receive it.
routeCacheReview.conclusion: The unchanged string namespace cannot import an old process's cached claim into a new process. A source edit without process reload also does not replace already-loaded executable modules. No actual new-code/old-claim cross-release cache path was found; no namespace change or blanket cache clear is warranted.

verification.method: esbuild metadata of both actual runtime dependency graphs, exact archive/helper byte comparison, source and full-manifest identity sensitivity, and four in-memory retained-code refusal probes.
notRun: No full producer rerun; parent's old-source full run left untouched.
